eventRetentionAudit.StoryEvent: SQL history only. React Query requests bounded pages (normally 100; headlines request 350); it never enters RECS.
eventRetentionAudit.OpenRelicChestEvent: Global event subscription writes received event entities into RECS; no explicit retention cap exists.
eventRetentionAudit.ExplorerRewardEvent: Currently enters through both event and bounded-spatial channels and the spatial bootstrap snapshot; S2 manifest adjudication required.
eventRetentionAudit.BattleEvent: Currently enters through both event and bounded-spatial channels and the spatial bootstrap snapshot; S2 manifest adjudication required.
eventRetentionAudit.snapshotLimit: The former EVENT_QUERY_LIMIT=40000 is an entity query limit, not StoryEvent retention; S1 renamed it ENTITY_QUERY_LIMIT.
eventRetentionAudit.chosenPolicy: S2 delivers event effects once and keeps no event history as RECS truth. Recovery does not replay effects. A fixed FIFO of at most 512 event identities per model may be retained for deduplication and diagnostics; immutable history remains in SQL.

comparisonContract.s4Requirement: Used heap must be strictly below this S1 baseline under the same scenario, and no current live fact may have more than one authoritative copy.
